name: v3.5.4
body:
## What's Changed
* feat: support global Alibaba Cloud endpoint suffix overrides by @CodeSpaceiiii in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1499
* feat: enable signature V4 for kebab-case OpenAPI commands by @yndu13 in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1491
* Replace legacy OpenAPI transport with the V2 SDK by @yndu13 in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1495
* Update CLI sources for v3.5.4 by @yndu13 in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1503
* Prepare the v3.5.4 release by @yndu13 in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1504
* fix: recover the v3.5.4 release workflow by @yndu13 in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1506


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/compare/v3.5.3...v3.5.4
